Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১) Hardly had we reached the school _______.

Explanation:
Scarcely/ hardly + had + past participle of the principal verb + when + past indefinite tense.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২) Lack of exercise and high fat diets have __________ to be factored in a heart attack.

For single adverb sentence “ H.V + adverb + verb in the past participle.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৩) Writing a beautiful sonnet is as much an achievement as _______ a 400-page novel.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:

preposition (as) + verb + ing.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৪) The doctor suggested that the patient _______ weight.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
verbs (demand, insist, suggest, urge, require) + that clause + present form of the verb (no s, es, ies, or ing)

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৫) The skill of safe driving _______ necessary to avoid collisions, which _______ many thousands of people annually.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
As there is annually, so the sentence will be in present indefinite tense.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৬) I would rather ___________ English fluently and impressively.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:

would rather that + present form of the verb.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৮) Roxana was asked to withdraw from graduate school because _________.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option1: ক) she was deemed incapable of completing her research
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option2: খ) the authority believed she was not really able to complete research

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option4: ঘ) her ability to finish research was not trusted
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
The adverbial clause of this sentence will follow the main clause. As the main clause structure is in passive construction, the adverbial clause will also be in the same structure.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ৯) If you don’t mind, I would rather not ___________.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:

would rather + present form of the verb

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১০) Professor Yunus will not be able to attend the meeting tonight because ___________.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option2: খ) he must to teach a class
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option3: গ) of he will teach a class
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.option4: ঘ) he will have teaching a class
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:

future continuous tense: shall/will + be + verb + ing

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১১) If he had worked hard, he _________the promotion. Fill in the blank with the right form of verb:
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
future continuous tense: যদি had/if যুক্ত clause টি past perfect tense হয় তাহলে পরের clause টি তে subject এর পর would have/could have/might have বসে এবং verb এর past participle form হয়।
Correct Sentence: If he had worked hard, he would have got the promotion

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১২) Fill in the blank with the right form of the verb: Rehan was so ill that he_____not attend the class.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
ব্যতিক্রমগুলো ছাড়া Principle clause এর verb যদি past tense হয় তাহলে subordinate clause এর verb ও past tense হবে এবং একটি present tense হলে অন্যটিও present tense হবে।
Correct Sentence: Rehan was so ill that he could not attend the class.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৩) While ______ through the garden, I found a gold ear-ring there. Fill in the blank.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
While এর পর verb থাকলে সেটির সাথে ing যোগ হয়।

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৪) Jishan said that he ______home the next week. Fill in the blank.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
Main clause এর verb টি past tense হলে ও পরের অংশে next day, next week, next month, next year ইত্যাদি উল্লেখ থাকলে subject এর পরে should/would বসে।

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৫) My father called me many times _________. Fill in the blank with the use of correct prepositions.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৬) It is composed ______ some good components. Fill in the blank with the use of correct prepositions.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৭) The criminal died _____ the scaffold. Fill in the blank with the use of correct prepositions.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
Die on = ফাঁসির মঞ্চে মারা যাওয়া।
Die at = পণ করে মারা যাওয়া।
Die off/from = ক্ষত হতে মারা যাওয়া।
Die for = দেশের জন্য /অজানা কারণে মারা যাওয়া।
Die through = অনীহা দ্বারা মারা যাওয়া।
Die by = সংক্রামক রোগ/মহামারী দ্বারা মারা মৃত্যু।

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৮) He was disappointed _____ my attitude. Fill in the blank with the use of correct prepositions.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
Disappointed + in/at = আমরা যা আশা করেছিলাম তা না হওয়ায় আমরা হতাশ
Disappointed + of = অন্যদিক থেকে কিছু পেতে ব্যর্থ হলে।
Correct Sentence: He was disappointed in my attitude.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ১৯) Rahima should speak ______ her father about the topic.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
কোন সুনির্দিষ্ট বিষয় কথা বলা বোঝালে speak to a person হয়।
তবে কথোপকথন (conversation) বোঝালে speak with a person হয়।

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২০) They looked ______ the building.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
Look + over = পরীক্ষা করা।
Look + at = তাকানো
Look + after = দেখাশুনা করা।
Look + for = খোজার চেষ্ঠা।

look upon = বিবেচনা করা।

Explanation:

''Of'' is used after the verb ''warn'' + danger.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২২) Complete shutdown ________ observed today against new law.

Explanation:

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২৪) She stands a good chance, __________ only two people are contesting the seat and the other candidate is very unpopular.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
এখানে Since শব্দটি Preposition হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হবে।
এখানে She stands a good chance অর্থ হলো তার সাফল্যের সমূহ সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে।এরপর এই সাফল্যের কারণ হিসেবে Since কে আনা হয়েছে।

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২৫) A defect can be caused ____________ negligence by one of the members of a team.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:
Caused by negligence অর্থ অবহালজনিত কারণে।
কিন্তু কারণ, হেতু, কিংবা কোনো কিছুর উৎপাদক বা উৎস হিসেবে Cause এরপর 'for' বসে।
যেমনঃ There is no cause for anxiety.
আর অতীত কারণ সম্পর্কে বুঝালে Cause এরপর 'of' বসে।
যেমনঃ I know the cause of my failure.

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২৬) Soldiers were deployed ______ the border of the country.

Explanation:

Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.question: ২৮) The children are _____ the river.
Fill in the Blanks (Right form of Verb,.exp:
Explanation:

At ব্যবহৃত হলে পানির কাছাকাছি বোঝায়।
